# Vibe Workflow for mdspace

## Standard Workflow for Changes

### 1. Create a Feature Branch
```bash
# From main branch
git checkout main
git pull origin main

# Create new branch with descriptive name
git checkout -b feat/description-of-changes
git push origin feat/description-of-changes
```

### 2. Validate Changes in Headless Browser (Port 3000)

**Start the dev server:**
```bash
cd /Users/aapokojo/Projects/mdspace
npm run dev  # Runs on port 3000 by default
```

**Test in headless browser:**
```bash
# Option 1: Use existing Chrome/Safari
open -a "Google Chrome" --args --app="http://localhost:3000" --window-size=1200,800
# or
open -a Safari "http://localhost:3000"

# Option 2: Headless testing with Playwright (if configured)
npx playwright test

# Option 3: curl to check server is running
curl -s http://localhost:3000 > /dev/null && echo "Server running"
```

**Manual Testing Checklist:**
- [ ] Create boxes
- [ ] Select boxes (no jumping)
- [ ] Move boxes (text stays inside)
- [ ] Double-click text to edit
- [ ] Space + drag for panning
- [ ] Mouse scroll for vertical, Shift+scroll for horizontal
- [ ] AI panel visible above footer
- [ ] Nested canvas navigation

### 3. Fix Errors

**Common issues:**

| Issue | Fix |
|-------|-----|
| Build errors | Run `npx tsc --noEmit` to check TypeScript |
| Next.js errors | Check `.next/dev/logs/next-development.log` |
| Port 3000 in use | Kill process: `lsof -i :3000 -t | xargs kill -9` |
| Canvas not updating | Check store dependencies in useEffect |

**Debug commands:**
```bash
# TypeScript check
npx tsc --noEmit

# Kill processes on port 3000
lsof -i :3000 -t | xargs -r kill -9 2>/dev/null

# View Next.js dev logs
tail -f .next/dev/logs/next-development.log
```

### 4. Push Branch and Create PR

```bash
# Add all changes
git add -A

# Commit with descriptive message
git commit -m "feat/fix: description of changes

Generated by Mistral Vibe.
Co-Authored-By: Mistral Vibe <vibe@mistral.ai>"

# Push branch to origin
git push origin feat/description-of-changes

# Create PR on GitHub
# 1. Go to https://github.com/aapokojo/mdspace
# 2. Click "Pull requests" > "New pull request"
# 3. Set base: main, compare: feat/description-of-changes
# 4. Add description and reviewers
# 5. Click "Create pull request"
```

## Quick Reference

| Task | Command |
|------|---------|
| Check current branch | `git branch --show-current` |
| See changes | `git status` |
| Run TypeScript check | `npx tsc --noEmit` |
| Start dev server | `npm run dev` |
| Kill port 3000 | `lsof -i :3000 -t | xargs -r kill -9` |
| Open in browser | `open http://localhost:3000` |

## Troubleshooting

### Port already in use
```bash
# Find and kill the process
lsof -i :3000
# Note the PID, then:
kill -9 <PID>

# Or kill all node processes
pkill -9 -f node
```

### TypeScript errors
- Check for type mismatches in callbacks
- Ensure all function parameters have explicit types
- Run `npx tsc --noEmit` for full error output

### Fabric.js issues
- Ensure fabric is loaded before creating canvas
- Check that event handlers are properly attached
- Verify object positions are being set correctly

### Store update loops
- Avoid calling store updates in render loops
- Use `useEffect` with proper dependencies
- Batch updates when possible to prevent multiple re-renders
